name: group-by-with-rows-link-and-count
dql: TABLE rows.file.link, length(rows) FROM "books" GROUP BY author
oqx: select key, c0: collect(path), c1: count() from docs where path.startsWith("/books/") or path == "/books.md" group by key: author

name: group-by-alias
dql: TABLE rows.title FROM "books" GROUP BY author AS writer SORT writer
oqx: select writer, c0: collect(data.title) from docs where path.startsWith("/books/") or path == "/books.md" group by writer: author order by writer

name: group-by-key-is-the-key
dql: TABLE key, length(rows) AS n GROUP BY status SORT key
oqx: select key, c0: key, n: count() from docs group by key: status order by key

name: aggregates
dql: TABLE sum(rows.pages) AS pages, min(rows.due) AS first, max(rows.due) AS last, average(rows.rating) AS avg FROM "books" GROUP BY author
oqx: select key, pages: sum(pages), first: min(due), last: max(due), avg: avg(rating) from docs where path.startsWith("/books/") or path == "/books.md" group by key: author

name: any-all-none
dql: TABLE any(rows.done), all(rows.done), none(rows.done) GROUP BY project
oqx: select key, c0: any(done), c1: all(done), c2: !any(done) from docs group by key: project

name: where-after-group-is-having
dql: TABLE length(rows) AS count FROM "notes" WHERE status = "open" GROUP BY project WHERE length(rows) > 1 SORT length(rows) DESC
oqx: select key, count: count() from docs where (path.startsWith("/notes/") or path == "/notes.md") and status == "open" group by key: project having count() > 1 order by count() desc

name: sort-before-group-orders-the-rows
dql: TABLE rows.file.link FROM "books" SORT file.mtime DESC GROUP BY author
oqx: select key, c0: rows collect { v: path values order by updated_at desc } from docs where path.startsWith("/books/") or path == "/books.md" group by key: author

name: sort-before-group-with-no-rows-column-warns
dql: TABLE length(rows) FROM "books" SORT file.mtime DESC GROUP BY author
oqx: select key, c0: count() from docs where path.startsWith("/books/") or path == "/books.md" group by key: author
warnings: SORT before GROUP BY orders the rows inside each group, and no column reads the rows — it has no effect

error.message: GROUP BY file.folder: OQX has no basename/dirname, and grouping by the path would mean one group per document (at line 1, column 22)

name: list-grouped
dql: LIST rows.file.link FROM "books" GROUP BY author
oqx: select key, value: collect(path) from docs where path.startsWith("/books/") or path == "/books.md" group by key: author

name: task-grouped-by-file
oqx: select key, tasks: rows collect { id: id, text: text, checked: checked, path: path } from blocks where type == "task" and !checked group by key: path

name: task-grouped-sorted
dql: TASK SORT file.mtime DESC GROUP BY file.link SORT key
oqx: select key, tasks: rows collect { id: id, text: text, checked: checked, path: path order by doc.updated_at desc } from blocks where type == "task" group by key: path order by key

name: bare-rows-column
dql: TABLE rows FROM "a" GROUP BY status
oqx: select key, c0: rows collect { path: path } from docs where path.startsWith("/a/") or path == "/a.md" group by key: status

name: page-field-after-group-is-unsupported
dql: TABLE author FROM "books" GROUP BY author

error.message: field author: after GROUP BY only `key` (the group key) and `rows` are in scope — Dataview reads a page field there as null (at line 1, column 7)

name: second-group-is-unsupported
dql: TABLE rows FROM "a" GROUP BY status GROUP BY key

error.message: a second GROUP BY: OQX groups once; grouping the groups is not expressible (at line 1, column 37)
rows: `rows` exists only after GROUP BY (at line 1, column 7)
CALENDAR … GROUP BY: a calendar places pages, not groups (at line 1, column 14)
GROUP BY: the server's OQX has no grouping (spec/oqx < 0.24); capabilities.groupBy is false

name: group-key-alias-collides-with-the-envelope
dql: TABLE rows GROUP BY author AS path

error.message: GROUP BY … AS path: the key's name must be an OQX identifier other than id/path (at line 1, column 12)
